The solver is rhoCentralFoam, set in system/controlDict as application rhoCentralFoam;.
The flow is unsteady, compressible, and single-component (air treated as a perfect gas).
The mesh is 2D, extruded exactly one cell in the z-direction, with the frontAndBack boundary patch set to type empty.
The thermophysical model in constant/thermophysicalProperties uses rhoHEThermo<perfectGas, JANAF, sutherland>.
The equation of state is perfectGas, the thermodynamic database is JANAF, and the viscosity model is Sutherland with coefficients S0=1.716e-5, T0=350 K, mu0=1726.
The nozzle inlet boundary condition is fixedValue for U, p, and T, with U = (686 0 0) m/s, T = 300 K, and p = 101325 Pa, representing a supersonic inflow at Mach 2.0 with no pressure feedback.
The far-field outlet boundary condition is waveTransmissive for p and T, and zeroGradient for U.
All solid wall boundaries use the noSlip condition.
The frontAndBack patch is of type empty and carries no boundary conditions.
No artificial viscosity, turbulence model, or multi-component mixture is included.
